## Spec

A component writes this trait's fields under `spec.tcpRoute`.

```cue
spec: tcpRoute: #TcpRouteSchema

#TcpRouteSchema: #RouteAttachmentSchema & {
	rules: [#TcpRouteRuleSchema, ...#TcpRouteRuleSchema]
}

// Shared attachment fields for route schemas (gateway, TLS, className).
#RouteAttachmentSchema: {
	gatewayRef?: {
		name!:      string
		namespace?: string
	}
	tls?: {
		mode?: "Terminate" | "Passthrough"
		certificateRef?: {
			name!:      string
			namespace?: string
		}
	}
	...
}

// No L7 match fields for TCP.
#TcpRouteRuleSchema: #RouteRuleBase

// Base fields shared by all route rules.
#RouteRuleBase: {
	backendPort!: uint & >=1 & <=65535
	...
}
```

## Notes

Renders a TCPRoute when the component also attaches the expose trait.

## Served by

These transformers in `opmodel.dev/catalogs/opm@v4` version `4.4.4` require this trait or read it when present.

| `tcp-route-transformer` | required | Creates Gateway API TCPRoutes for components with TcpRoute and Expose traits |
